name: debuggerseats
description: Package JSON que ayudará a levantar a todos los servicios del proyecto desde una sola consola.

scripts.install:all: cd add-restaurant-service && pnpm install && cd ../authenthication_server && pnpm install && cd ../client-admin && pnpm install && cd ../client-user && pnpm install
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "AUTH,RESTAURANTS,REPORTS,CLIENT,CLIENT-USER" -c "cyan,blue,yellow,green,magenta" "pnpm run auth" "pnpm run restaurants" "pnpm run reports" "pnpm run client" "pnpm run client-user"
